newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Praxair Inc started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Praxair Inc started as buy.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers said it initiated coverage of Praxair Inc with a buy rating and a $55 a share price target.

-- said Praxair's earnings per share growth in both 1997 and 1998 could be more than double that of the Standard & Poors 500 index. Expects Praxair to earn $2.60 a share in 1997 and $3.05 a share in 1998.
-- said Praxair enjoys significant earnings leverage in some of the most rapidly growing economies of the world, including Brazil, Argentina, China and India.
-- Praxair lost 1-3/4 to 50-1/8 in late morning trading.
